item.title: Stanford’s big AI bet: what if it busts?
item.description: Stanford is uniquely exposed to AI. Master's student Utsav Gupta predicts what a bust would look like, and the hedges we can put in place. The post Stanford’s big AI bet: what if it busts? appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: The last true American family
item.description: Where did we go wrong as a country? Perhaps when we took away the last true vestige of freedom: the right of a parent to hit a blinker with their next-of-kin. The post The last true American family appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Stanford’s role in Super Bowl LX goes beyond the practice field
item.description: As the Patriots settle in at Stanford Stadium this week for Super Bowl practice, the behind-the-scenes efforts continue to be crucial. The post Stanford’s role in Super Bowl LX goes beyond the practice field appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Stanford-founded startup develops wearable for continuous hormone monitoring
item.description: Clair, a Stanford-founded startup, is developing a wearable hormone tracking device to give women noninvasive insights into their hormonal health, with plans for FDA approval and a 2026 launch. The post Stanford-founded startup develops wearable for continuous hormone monitoring appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Wikimedia explains combating AI in HAI seminar
item.description: Chris Petrillo, Principal Product Manager at Wikimedia Enterprise, talked about AI bots, human editors and the convergence of the two entities on Wikipedia. The post Wikimedia explains combating AI in HAI seminar appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: University pushes back against updated county blueprint for campus growth
item.description: The University believes the county’s updated Stanford Community Plan would hinder its ability to address affiliate needs. The post University pushes back against updated county blueprint for campus growth appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: ‘We will not cooperate with that behavior’: San Jose bans ICE from using town property
item.description: Ahead of large crowds for Super Bowl Weekend, San Jose prohibited ICE's use of public facilities. The post ‘We will not cooperate with that behavior’: San Jose bans ICE from using town property appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: GSC defers bill to proportionally split activity costs with undergraduate students
item.description: The Graduate Student Council deferred a bill to change the current split rule in student activities costs with undergraduate fee funding, demanding more detailed statistics.
